confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Thai provincial tourist pricing; no live menus, listings or booking pages were checked. Food anchors are more reliable; hostel and hotel rates vary by season and room type. Cocktail and wine_glass are inferred from the beer anchor (about 2.6x and 3.1x beer) because direct knowledge is weak. Baht prices were converted at an assumed 32-33 THB per USD. The FX observation comes from search-result summaries attributed to the RBA exchange-rates page; the RBA table was not read directly, so verify it before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No specific comparable city was supplied. Ayutthaya is treated as a small Central Thailand heritage town and day-trip destination, priced near similar provincial tourist towns such as Kanchanaburi and Lopburi and below Bangkok. Hotel tiers reflect Thai provincial guesthouse and three-star rates.
